Callout.Name: Incident at Roadworks
Callout.Message: Vehicle has gone through a roadworks closure.
Callout.Advisory: No injuries, cones scattered, workers shaken.

Script.Line: He went straight through the closure and the lads had to jump.
It is forty miles an hour through there and he did not brake.
The signs were up. They have been up all morning.

Lines.Approach: Nobody is hurt, which is remarkable. The workers want him found.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
